items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: where we mostly had Pierron and Celestine

ctx.x: And you have all your life been going to the same debutante parties. Yes. And you've been all the time at the party.

I never have remembered, even at the patio raw, where most of our... You know a lot of the debutante parties, where we mostly had Pierron and Celestine. There might have been a time there where they had a few white bands, but if so, I wasn't conscious of it. And, you know, I mean, they weren't very good in my opinion, and I don't even remember them.

But what about, uh... you know, the friends interested in it, uh... Are there people who do you know it's among white New Orleans and interestingly maintained throughout the years, during the thirties and the parties?
